question: Implement and verify the Conversationalist and the shared ticket receipt and recovery (LiveOS design 2026-11-25, phases 2-3).
evidence_needed: test output, the files changed, the handoff
done_when: tools/conversationalist.py and its tests exist; a correction survives a restart; the same request filed twice gives one ticket and one delivered result with provenance; local, ledger, committed and remote acknowledgment are told apart; simulated and actual voice delivery are recorded differently; approvals still needed are listed; the coordinator and conversationalist test suites pass in a recorded run.
